newsitem.title: USA: Big Flower's Reilly to add CEO post.
newsitem.headline: Big Flower's Reilly to add CEO post.

text.p: Big Flower Press Holdings Inc said Tuesday that the board has named its president, Edward Reilly, to the additional post of chief executive officer.

Reilly replaces founder Theodore Ammon in the CEO post. Ammon, who has been CEO since the advertising and market services company was founded in 1993, continues to be chairman and will continue to focus on long-term strategy for the company, it said.
Reilly joined Big Flower as president and chief operating officer in April 1996 after more than two decades in the advertising, broadcasting and publishing businesses.

Before joining Big Flower, he had been president of McGraw-Hill Broadcasting for nearly a decade. Prior to that, he was executive vice president of McGraw-Hill International Book Publishing, overseeing subsidiaries around the world, A
member of the Board of Directors of the Ad Council, Reilly also serves on the Board of Trustees of Lynchburg College in Virginia.
